verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v1: ḥayātuka fī d-dunyā humūmu waʾaḥzānu walaw fī jināni l-gharbi ʾidh khāra ʾīmānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v2: waman lam yakun rabbu s-samāwāti rabbahu yaqūdu khuṭāhu lil-fawāḥishi shayṭānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v3: famā ʿālimu ʾaw faylasūfu waḥākimu yuʿāliju yawmā mā yuqāsīhi shubbānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v4: fafī l-ʾarḍi taqdīru wafī l-ʾarḍi ḥikmahu ʾidhā ntafayā ʿanhā ntafā ʿanka burhānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v5: fatarkību ʾālāti waḍabṭu qarārati bimuqtaḍayāti lā yafīhhina ʾinsānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v6: falaysa maʿa l-ʾalwāni ʾillā hawāyatu wakullu maʿāni lil-hawāyati ʾalwānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v7: wamā ladhdhaḍu ʾillā ʿalayhā tarattabat maṣāʾibu hal tarḍā l-maṣāʾiba ʾaʿyānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v8: ʾayumkinuka stifrāghu mā fī ladhāʾidhi ʾidhā stukhlifa l-ʾaḥwālu ʾaw thāra ʾikhwānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v9: ʾataghtarru bil-ʾanṣābi yawmā warijzihā waqad kharra maytā min ʿaṣāhu sulaymānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v10: wakāna nabiyyā muṭmaʾinnā bimulkihi walam yughwihi fī ḥālati l-manni ṭughyānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v11: kadhalika rabbā l-muṣṭafā bikhilālihi wamin sādati l-ḥusnā bilalu wasalmānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v12: faʾawwalu man qad jāʾa bid-dīni wad-dunā rafīqayni ḥattā yafhama l-ghayba wildānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v13: fashāʿa bīʾāfāqi l-basīṭati rushduhu wajāhada kulla l-ʾaghbiyā ḥaythumā kānū
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v14: wakhāṭabahum bil-ḥaqqi qabla shtighālihi bisayfi walawlā ẓ-ẓulmu mā qāma ʿuthmānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v15: wamā shtadda ḍidda l-ʾaqwiyā ibnu ṭālibi walam yaʾati liṣ-ṣiddīqi fī l-juhdi ʾaʿwānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v16: walam yajʿali l-fārūqu mā liḥayātihi mina l-fakhri rahnā wahwa fī l-ʿadli mīzānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v17: wakāna l-ghinā lil-faqri ʿabdā wakhādimā wakāna th-tharā bil-faḍli wal-ʾamni yazdānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v18: wanaḥnu maʿa l-ʾayyāmi ʿishnā tajarruʾā wamā khtalla min kanzi t-tijāniyyī ʿirfānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v19: walam nakhsha makrā min ʿaduwwi wasāḥiri yuqāwimunā bir-rajmi war-rajmu ʿudwānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v20: walam nakhsha ʾillā llāha shukrā lifaḍlihi watarku ʿtirāfi bil-maḥāmidi khusrānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v21: lanā fī hudā khayri ṭ-ṭarīqati ʾasratu laqad bāyaʿū l-ʾaqṭāba fīhā wamā hānū
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v22: lahum min waṣāyā jaddihi mā lijaddihi wakullu waṣāyā l-jaddi lil-ʾahli taḥnānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v23: lahum rawḍaḍu ghannāʾu fāḥat bisirrihim wafī s-sirri rawḥu fī n-nufūsi warayḥānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v24: waṣānū lahu mā fī l-mashāhidi ʾaḥrufā waṣāna lahum min ʾaḥrufi mithla mā ṣānū
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v25: wasammāhu sulṭāna s-salāṭīni wad-dī wamā thamma min baʿdi t-tijāniyyī sulṭānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v26: lahum fīhi bayna l-ʿālamiyyāti barzakhu wafī kulli dāʿi lil-ḥaqāʾiqi miʿwānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v27: jubiltu bimā fīhi r-riḍā lī walī l-hawā wahā ʾanā min ḥubbi l-khalīfati sakrānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v28: taʿʿaraftu bil-ʾāyāti lammā ʿaraftuhu waqad farra ʿannī ḥīna bāyaʿtu ghīlānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v29: ʾabī waʾabī mā lil-kirāmu ʿadīluhu kamā darasat minhu l-futuwwata fityānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v30: daʿawtu ʾimāmī wahuwa fī l-qabri ṣāmitu wamā ṣumtuhu ʾillā mabādi waʾarkānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v31: liʾaqḍī bihi fī l-mawqifayni ḥawāʾijā wamā ḥājatī ʾillā rtiqāʾu waʾiḥsānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v32: wakāna ṣ-ṣafā yurḍīhi qayda ḥayātihi wayurḍīhi ʾikhlāṣu wayurḍīhi riḍwānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v33: yurāqibu ʾaʿmāla l-warā biḥudūdihā wayanṣaḥuhum ʾin jāwazū l-ḥadda ʾaw shānū
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v34: wadahrā yurāʿī l-waqta wal-waqtu layyinu liman min rijāli llāhi rāʿūhu ʾaw lānū
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v35: lahu qalamu yaḥkīhi ḥālā wamishyata wafī sh-shiʿri ʾimmā jāda bish-shiʿri ḥassānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v36: ʾasālībuhu fī l-madḥi tabdū kaʾannahā tudhakkiru mā fī ṭībihi wahwa rayyānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v37: faṣāra kamamdūḥi walaw kāna mādiḥā tadākhala ʾawṣāfu waṣādaqa ʾawzānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v38: ʾatāka ʾabā bakri madīḥī waʾinnamā yuthābu mruʾu kaymā yuraqqīhi mannānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v39: famā ṣāliḥu ʾillā biẓillika ʿayshuhu walā ṭālibu ʾillā ʾilā l-ḥaqqi yaqẓānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v40: ʾunādīka ʾaḥyānā ʾidhā ḥtāja manṭiqī ʾilā sāmiʿi minhu l-ʾishāratu tibyānu
verses.hayatuka-fi-d-dunya-c1-v41: waʾarjūka fawqa l-kulli willāhu shāhidu ʾafī l-ʾarḍi min baʿdi l-khalīfati sukkānu
